meta.title: Dynamic time extension (trigger 2 min, extend by 2 min) auction: what each side sees during bidding
gaps: Configure an auction with a dynamic time-extension trigger of 2 minutes and extension of 2 minutes
Place Vendor B's bid exactly one minute before the original auction end
Verify that the auction end time moves two minutes later for every vendor and the buyer
Verify the participants panel reports Dynamic time extended as a result of the trigger
Verify the Order Activity entry specifically records the dynamic extension event

steps.note: Opens the single-stage event creation flow requested by the case.
Configures the closest supported auction type; dynamic time extension is not available in this step.
Provides the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Applies the reverse-auction pricing template before adding products.
Adds the requested product and quantity; plant-location selection is not expressible in this step.
Fills the pricing sheet so the auction can be published.
Sets and commits the 30-minute auction schedule.
Invites three QA vendors to approximate Vendors A, B, and C without inventing vendor names.
Publishes the auction so vendor bidding can occur.
Confirms the auction reached a published project page.
Submits a bid for the first invited vendor; the catalog cannot schedule it relative to the auction end.
Confirms the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submits the requested lower bid for a second vendor, but without the required one-minute-before-end timing.
Confirms the second vendor bid was accepted.
Checks the buyer's Responses view for the two submitted vendor bids.
